label: PF Backlog 552
title: Fix global /pf and /wg command docs: known-checkout path resolved to the wrong repo
body:
## Why
The global /pf and /wg command docs hardcoded a 'known checkout' path pointing at a DIFFERENT repo
(...\Exploring\product-forge, ...\Exploring\workergrid) that lacks this session's commands (e.g. restamp),
so STEP 0 resolved the wrong tree.

## What
Point the known checkout at the active repo (...\Exploring\PF-validation\product-forge\scripts\pf.py and
...\PF-validation\workergrid\wg.py); re-copy to ~/.config/opencode/command/.

## Verify
- pf_surface_check + wg_surface_check OK (installed copies byte-identical).
